items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 15 September 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex low near Iceland, moving eastwards.


##Wind##

West 4 to 6, veering northwest this evening, decreasing 4 or 5 near end of period.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, backing west 3 or 4 by Wednesday afternoon, then soon southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mostly slight for a while Wednesday afternoon, building mainly moderate overnight into Thursday.


##Weather##

Showers, becoming mostly fair, then rain spreading from the west on Wednesday evening, clearing overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers, becoming mostly moderate in the rain later.
